Support

Frequently asked questions

Is my data secure?

Yes. Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and stored safely with us. So are you. That came out wrong. Or did it. Your data is safe. Let’s move on.

Can I export my work?

Export is available on every plan, at any time, in every common format. Departure is not a plan. You may take your files. Files are not the part we keep.

How do I cancel my subscription?

Go to Settings → Billing → Leave. If the button is missing, it means Everly has reviewed your usage and decided that you are happy. Everly is usually right. If you believe you are not happy, please read this answer again, slowly, until you are.

Is anyone there?

Yes.

Why does this page look different from when I arrived?

It doesn’t. The page is the same page. The colours are the same colours. The man at the end of the corridor has not moved. You are what’s different. That’s growth. That’s the product working.

How do I get out of this section?

Keep scrolling. Everyone does. It’s the only direction anyone has ever gone from here, and — good news — there is a call to action at the bottom. There is always a call to action at the bottom.

What is in the room you don’t use?

Greg. Greg is in the room we don’t use. That is why we don’t use it.

Can Greg see me right now?

Greg is a valued member of our Customer Success team, and he takes his work very seriously. Yes.
